description:
Cast Triumphant Reckoning by paying {6}{W}{W}{W}.
In response, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, copying Triumphant Reckoning.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, causing any player to mill two cards.
Resolve a copy of Triumphant Reckoning, returning all nonland permanent cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
